description: Return home listings with address, price, beds and baths from a Zillow search URL. Input is a site URL, not a keyword. For general search use google_search. Required: url.

results.description: Maximum number of listings to return.

url.description: Zillow search URL, for example https://www.zillow.com/homes/Austin,-TX_rb/ (short forms like https://www.zillow.com/austin-tx/ are converted).

name: search_zillow
title: Search Zillow
